//: The envelope every workforce message carries, as a JSON Schema an orchestrator validates each message against: who sends it to whom, what it asks, when it is due, whether it waits on the owner, and the task's state.
title: Workforce message

thread.description: The id of the request this message belongs to; a new request's own id.

from.description: The sending agent's id, or owner.

to.description: The receiving agent's id, or owner.

venture.description: The venture this is for: its folder name under Ventures/ in the owner's vault, personal for the owner's own life, or workforce for work on the workforce itself. A task the owner frames across ventures names each one, separated by commas.

via.description: chief-of-staff when the Chief of Staff relayed it between departments; empty otherwise.

context.description: Everything the receiver needs, restated, never 'see above'.

ask.description: One task, starting with a verb, and the shape of the answer; empty for a notice.

done_when.description: The check that proves the task is finished.

due.description: The due date as YYYY-MM-DD; empty when there is none.

gate.description: owner when the work waits on the owner's yes.

state.description: The task's state as of this message.

hops.description: How many times the task has been handed over since a seat accepted it, never more than 2; the Chief of Staff's relay and a Director's first assignment are the route, not hops.

attachments.description: Paths or links, each with its date.

sent.description: When it was sent, as ISO 8601 with the time zone offset.
